Between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] undertook a '''mission''' to recover the [[Talisman (artifact)|Talisman]], an artifact created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to bait the Alliance with false rumors of its invisibility-granting qualities.<ref name="TCDV">{{SWArchive|url=episode-v/bts/article/f20070124/index.html|text=Time Capsule: Darth Vader 1980}}</ref> Launching in the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from an Alliance [[Ring Base|base]] in an [[Unidentified asteroid field (Rebel Alliance base)|asteroid field]], Rebel-allied [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] recovered the Talisman and discovered that it produced a [[sleeping virus]] that rendered [[Human/Legends|Humans]] unconscious. Solo was indeed a Human, and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] accordingly hung his prone form upside-down, as allowing [[Blood/Legends|blood]] to rush to the head was the only way to keep him alive.<ref name="Story of the Faithful Wookiee" />

Returning to and narrowly avoiding a collision with the Rebel Base, Chewbacca flew the ''Millennium Falcon'' to the [[Panna system/Legends|Panna system]], followed by [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] in a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]]. There, the two [[Starship/Legends|ships]] crashed on the [[Water/Legends|water]]-covered [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Panna Prime]]. Their [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] disabled, Skywalker and the droids were a attacked by a [[Panna dragon|native creature]], only to be rescued by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was in reality working with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a plot to uncover the location of the hidden Rebel base.<ref name="Story of the Faithful Wookiee" />

Following [[Paar's ichthyodont|Boba Fett's mount]] in the ejected [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of their Y-wing, the Rebels arrived at the downed ''Falcon'', where Skywalker watched as Chewbacca destroyed the talisman, though not before he, also a human, was infected with the sleeping virus. Fett was familiar with the virus as an Imperial weapon, and left for a [[Panna City|nearby city]] to acquire a [[Serum (sleeping virus)|remedy]], reluctantly allowing Chewbacca to accompany him. In the city, Fett separated from Chewbacca and located the serum as promised, while also covertly contacting Darth Vader.<ref name="Story of the Faithful Wookiee" />

Fighting off Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] pursuit as they left the city, the pair returned to the ''Falcon'' and administered the serum to the afflicted humans, saving their lives and awakening them from their sleep.<ref name="Story of the Faithful Wookiee" /> Solo, familiar with Boba Fett, failed to recognize the bounty hunter due to the after-effects of the sleeping virus,<ref name="EGtC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and a grateful Skywalker offered to bring Fett to the Rebel base. However, the droids had intercepted the transmission between Vader and the bounty hunter, and revealed Fett's duplicity. Following his escape via [[Z-6 jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], the Rebel group left Panna Prime aboard the ''Falcon''.<ref name="Story of the Faithful Wookiee" />

Later, an [[Unidentified Rebel cartoon|edited recording]] of the mission was given as a gift by Chewbacca to his son, [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|10|Panna system}}</ref> while Imperial records of the event were classified.<ref name="BFDB">{{DB|character|bobafett|Fett, Boba}}</ref>
